verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS workflow platform with a CLI, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The List usage records API (pipedream-docs-19) only retrieves billing and credit-consumption data and is not an opt-out control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
